decisions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 scale의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?
decisions.passage:
(A) They possessed ideas about how some aspect of daily life could be improved on a larger <u>scale</u>. Through diligence and experience, they improved upon their ideas by sharing them with others.
(B) She placed the freshly caught fish on the kitchen <u>scale</u> to check its weight before cooking. The old <u>scale</u> displayed the numbers in red.

det.analysis:
① (A) 저울 — (B) 규모: 의미 반대
② (A) 규모 — (B) 규모: (B)는 저울
③ (A) 저울 — (B) 저울: (A)는 규모
④ (A) 규모 — (B) 저울 ←정답
det.tip: scale: 규모(on a larger scale) / 저울(kitchen scale)
